topic_title: Environmental Hazards — Low-Water, Fog, Ice & Wind
prompt: What emergency action is recommended if caught in a sudden blinding West Texas dust storm (haboob)?

options.text: Stop in the center travel lane and turn on high-beam headlights to pierce dust
Accelerate quickly to outrun the dust cloud before total zero visibility hits
Drive on the left shoulder facing against oncoming traffic to see lane lines
Pull off pavement, park, turn off lights, take foot off brake, stay buckled
